description: Freshness SLAs for critical artifacts. The sentinel alerts when an artifact's age exceeds max_age_minutes INSIDE its active window. 'Process ran' is not health — 'output is fresh and valid' is. Windows are UTC hours (trading-relevant only); omit for 24/7.

master bridge fires */15 during NY window; silence here = bridge cron dead
signal arbitration hourly-ish; stale = signal stack down
